title: International Dance Club
specs: Owns one of the largest dance floors in Colorado at 4,500 sq. ft.
Weekly live band dances year round
Singles and couples welcome, no partner needed
Family friendly environment, not a nightclub scene
includes: Use of dance floor and facilities
blurb: The International Dance Club hosts weekly Saturday dances featuring live music and a variety of dance styles including ballroom, swing, country, Latin, and line dancing. They have their own 4,500 sq. ft. dance floor and emphasize partner dancing but welcome singles and couples. The club is family friendly and not a nightclub scene.
extraNote: Only club members may bring in or consume alcohol unless there is a Special Event License with a cash bar · No outside beverages allowed for non-members, including water · year round
